mapper.select:
SELECT a.`id`, a.`plan_name`, a.`plan_start_time`, a.`plan_end_time`,a.`open_time`,a.`close_time`,a.`is_enable`, a.`open_job_task_id`,a.`close_job_task_id`,a.`tenant`, a.`deleted`,a.`create_by`, a.`create_time`,a.`update_by`, a.`update_time` FROM `information_plan` a where a.`deleted` = 0
and a.`is_enable` = #{param.isEnable}
and a.`plan_name` like concat('%', #{param.planName}, '%')
order by a.`create_time` DESC

SELECT a.`id`, a.`plan_name`, a.`plan_start_time`, a.`plan_end_time`,a.`open_time`,a.`close_time`,a.`is_enable`,a.`execution_cycle`, a.`open_job_task_id`,a.`close_job_task_id`,a.`tenant`, a.`deleted`,a.`create_by`, a.`create_time`,a.`update_by`, a.`update_time` FROM `information_plan` a where a.`deleted` = 0 and a.`is_enable` = #{param.isEnable} and a.`plan_start_time` <= #{nowDate} and a.`plan_end_time` >= #{nowDate} order by a.`create_time` DESC

SELECT a.`id`, a.`plan_name`, a.`plan_start_time`, a.`plan_end_time`,a.`open_time`,a.`close_time`,a.`is_enable`,a.`execution_cycle`, a.`open_job_task_id`,a.`close_job_task_id`,a.`tenant`, a.`deleted`,a.`create_by`, a.`create_time`,a.`update_by`, a.`update_time` FROM `information_plan` a where a.`deleted` = 0 and a.`is_enable` = #{param.isEnable} and a.`plan_start_time` >= #{nowDate} and a.`plan_end_time` <= #{nowDate} order by a.`create_time` DESC

SELECT a.`id`, a.`code`, a.`area_name` `areaName`, a.`brand_code` `brandCode`, a.`device_id` `deviceId`, a.`device_name` `deviceName`, a.`area_id` `areaId`, a.`area_name` `areaName`, a.`device_prod_name` `deviceProdName`, a.`device_prod_category_name` `deviceProdCategoryName`, a.`device_prod_category_code` `deviceProdCategoryCode`, a.`device_prod_id` `deviceProdId`, a.`device_status` `deviceStatus`, a.`code` `deviceCode`, a.`third_party_id` `thirdPartyId`, a.`lnt_and_lat` `lntAndLat`, a.`communication_status` `communicationStatus`, a.`brand_name` `brandName` FROM `security_device` a where a.`deleted` = 0
and a.`application_code` =#{param.applicationCode}
and not exists(select a.`id` from `info_screen_schedule_assoc` issa where a.`id` = issa.`security_device_id`)
and ( a.`code` like concat('%', #{param.keyword}, '%') or a.`device_name` like concat('%', #{param.keyword}, '%') or a.`device_prod_name` like concat('%', #{param.keyword}, '%') or a.`area_name` like concat('%', #{param.keyword}, '%') or a.`brand_name` like concat('%', #{param.keyword}, '%') )
